reprocess_generate_output: parse a fairseq generate.py output file into source, hypothesis, score, target, and positional score dictionaries
reprocess_nbest_interactive_output: parse a fairseq interactive.py n-best output file into source, hypothesis, score, target, and positional score dictionaries
write_reprocessed_hypotheses: write reprocessed n-best hypotheses, sources, and targets to output files with optional BPE prefix truncation
remove_bpe_from_text: remove BPE subword symbols from a sentence or dictionary of sentences to recover original tokenization
get_score_reranking: compute a combined reranking score from bitext and language model scores with optional normalization and length penalty
